description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by bnd-0033. A Level 2 public node emits on / the Link header with the registered describedby relation and the linkset type (D82 Q3); every public artefact carries a quoted ETag equal to its SHA-256 and the wildcard origin; the discovery document, now.md and ledger are no-cache; immutable is emitted nowhere at 1.0.
note: added 2026-09-16 at rc.3 (pre-DS-4 audit); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (PUB-6 Q55d; D100). The vector asserts the header set of a node whose `site.base` it never states, so a port cannot tell which origin the `/` Link header and the route keys belong to. Superseded by bnd-0033, which states the base.
